messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync request 101010 Newport wants a short preflight bench to validate that our kernel patches don't regress perf/W on their boards before we flip the marketplace listing. Can we do a 3-hr validation window this Friday?
Liam O'Connor: We can join. Prefer window 01:00-04:00 UTC to avoid our daytime jobs. Scope: single model (llama-7b), seq=2048, batch=1 + streaming, and a power ramp (idle, 50%, 100%). We'll capture power and fan curves.
Ravi Gupta: I'll own the loadgen and result ingest. Plan: 3 runs per condition, 1500 steps each, warmup 200 steps. Scripts: infra/benchmarks/newport/preflight_run.sh and ingest to s3://redwood-bench/newport/preflight-2026/ with schema files/manifest.json.
Ivy Wong: I'll coordinate with Newport's firmware team (cc @Liam). Newport needs our exact kernel diff and a list of toolchain deps. I'll share via secure link. Also request: they export ACPI watt readings + INA sensor logs.
bench-bot: bench-scheduler scheduled job npf-778 on cluster rg-dedicated-usw1; runner: `./benchctl start --job npf-778 --cfg preflight.yaml`
Liam O'Connor: Kernel notes: my team will try the minimal patchset first (no aggressive SM clock). If stable, we'll test the patched scheduler. Proposed flags: `--sched=balanced`, `--kv_prefetch=0|1`, `--l2_wralloc=dynamic`. We'll only flip one flag per run to isolate effects.
Maya Chen: Measurement detail: align power samples to token emission using monotonic counters and insert `--sync-token` events in logs. Metric outputs: metrics.json (throughput, p50/p95, cpu% infra), power.csv (ts,dev,watts,ambient), and notes.md. Can we keep retention for two weeks in the bucket?
Ravi Gupta: Yes, retention set. I'll also push a quick ingestion lambda at infra/ops/ingest_newport_preflight.py to normalize units.
Ivy Wong: Newport contact Liam P (firmware) will host driver builds in their CI. I'll confirm build tags and artifactory path. Also scheduling: we'll do a 30-min dry run 30 minutes before the window to validate sensors.
Maya Chen: Owners: Maya (coordinator & write-up), Ravi (loadgen + ingestion), Ivy (partner access). Deliverables: s3 raw artifacts, a short google doc summary + a single-slide for comms highlighting any perf/W delta and whether we need to revert any patch.
Liam O'Connor: We'll also collect thermal telemetry; if we see fan ramp anomalies we might attribute perf drops to thermal throttling rather than kernel.
bench-bot: job npf-778 dry-run completed 162s162s; status OK. Logs: s3://redwood-bench/newport/preflight-2026/npf-778/dryrun.log
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. I'll post the calendar invite and a checklist. Please ping #eng-runtime if anything blocks. :rocket:
